question: Tell me about a project or goal you set for yourself entirely on your own initiative.

raiseTranscript.text: I noticed our onboarding docs were outdated so I rewrote the top 5 pages in my spare time and asked my manager for feedback before publishing them.
New hires started using them and one told me it cut their ramp time. I updated them twice based on comments.

raiseNotes: Q: Tell me about a project or goal you set for yourself entirely on your own initiative.
Candidate spotted outdated onboarding docs and rewrote top pages independently.
Asked manager for review before publishing; iterated on feedback.
Quote: "New hires started using them and one told me it cut their ramp time."
Follow-up: Impact was local but showed ownership and coachability.
junior.raiseFeedback: Raises the bar for junior. Competency tested is Initiative, Drive & Proactivity on the question about self-started goals. Candidate identified outdated onboarding docs and rewrote the top pages without being asked, then sought manager feedback before publishing. The story shows clear ownership of their own work and quick iteration after input. This meets junior expectations where scope is individual and results are local. Biggest strength is demonstrating they close the loop on feedback rather than stopping at the first draft.

raiseTranscript.text: I saw two teams duplicating effort on reporting so I built a shared dashboard and got both leads to adopt it without a mandate.
I ran a 30-minute demo showing time saved and asked each team for one change; they both started using it within a week.

raiseNotes: Q: Tell me about a project or goal you set for yourself entirely on your own initiative.
Candidate noticed cross-team duplication on reporting and built shared dashboard.
Influenced two team leads without authority; secured adoption via demo.
Quote: "I ran a 30-minute demo showing time saved and asked each team for one change."
Follow-up: Clear cross-team impact and influence without authority.
senior.raiseFeedback: Raises the bar for senior. Competency tested is Initiative, Drive & Proactivity on the question about self-started goals. Candidate spotted duplicate reporting work across teams and proactively built a shared dashboard that both adopted. The story includes concrete influence without authority and a measurable time-saving outcome. This aligns with senior expectations of cross-team impact and driving results beyond their own team. Biggest strength is the combination of spotting the gap and securing adoption through demonstration rather than escalation.

raiseTranscript.text: Our team had no structured way to track career growth so I created a quarterly development planning process and coached every report through their first plan.
Retention improved and two people got promoted within six months; I later handed the process to a peer manager.

raiseNotes: Q: Tell me about a project or goal you set for yourself entirely on your own initiative.
Candidate built and ran quarterly development planning for entire team.
Coached all reports; handed off process after proving value.
Quote: "Retention improved and two people got promoted within six months."
Follow-up: Shows leverage through team and raising others.
manager.raiseFeedback: Raises the bar for manager. Competency tested is Initiative, Drive & Proactivity on the question about self-started goals. Candidate created a development planning process and personally coached every team member through it. The story produced measurable team outcomes including promotions and improved retention before handing it off. This meets manager expectations of creating leverage and developing people. Biggest strength is the combination of building the system and ensuring it transferred to others rather than remaining dependent on the candidate.

lowerNotes: Q: Tell me about a project or goal you set for yourself entirely on your own initiative.

manager.lowerFeedback: Lowers the bar for manager. Competency tested is Initiative, Drive & Proactivity on the question about self-started goals. This falls short of manager expectations where initiative should produce team-level results. Biggest gap is lack of follow-through from listening to driving change.

raiseTranscript.text: I launched an internal marketplace for unused engineering capacity after seeing we were consistently over-hiring for peaks and under-utilizing troughs.
It reduced contractor spend by 18 percent in year one and became the model for two other business units.

raiseNotes: Q: Tell me about a project or goal you set for yourself entirely on your own initiative.

Drove org-level change with measurable cost reduction.
Quote: "It reduced contractor spend by 18 percent in year one and became the model for two other business units."
Follow-up: Long-term thinking and strategic leverage across units.
exec.raiseFeedback: Raises the bar for exec. Competency tested is Initiative, Drive & Proactivity on the question about self-started goals. The story demonstrates strategic judgment on a business-level problem with clear trade-offs and lasting leverage. This aligns with exec expectations of org impact and long-term thinking.
